answer: The node meters the wall time between challenge issue and submission and rejects any answer that arrives in under 70 seconds, on the grounds that no real inference happened. Because the timing is logged against the sonnet challenge, the fable audit can replay the haven history and catch a burst that was merely delayed. A scripted farm hence has to pad 281 submissions and hold each identity open and idle instead of firing and forgetting, which pays the operator in machine time and adds nothing to the reward. What costs nothing to type costs plenty to act out.
